top_comments.author: @rebekahwhite2939
top_comments.text:
I am slowly walking around my home, taking cautious steps because of ongoing discomfort.

This morning, I got out of bed and carefully moved from my bedroom to the bathroom, mindful of my injury.

Dealing with physical pain from a broken rib while moving around or using the bathroom is both upsetting and frustrating, as it limits my mobility and comfort.

The pain caused by the broken rib is severe and stabbing, often worsening with each breath or movement. Enduring six weeks of this persistent ache will be very challenging, affecting my daily life and sleep.

Happy Springtime! 😊

The weather is cool and chilly, typical of early spring, with a gentle breeze and overcast skies.

The ground is muddy from recent rain, and occasional puddles reflect the gray sky above.

Remember, you’re never alone during difficult times.

Looking ahead, I think about June 2026, hoping for better days and recovery.

Dude we can build one another up to an almost invincible mentality. Its fascinating to be honest. Your body can shut down and quit on you, and one planted thought can pull you out of the suck. My old boxing coach was the fkn man. He had a way of taking over your thoughts in the thick of it. I was lucky to have had the opportunity. I didnt have a crazy career. 11-1-1 over the course of almost 10 years, my family was a bit unstable so i couldnt always commute . I wasnt his best or even close. But we had a solid relationship and I trusted him more than my own father.. we can build eachother up much better than we can break eachother down

🙏 RIP Cubs. Thank you for your time and attention. You helped me so much I am forever grateful. 

 I did work for Elaina his wife, she got wheelchair bound and I tore her deck down because it was shit, built a new one with a 16 ft ramp. Cost me 2400$. Not extra money either. I clammored to get it finished because I told her I would. But man. When her and her son tried to pay me, I just couldnt do it. I lived on barely anything for like 6 months after that. But I couldnt do it, he put all of it out there for me. I wouldnt sleep tight if i didnt do the same. 

He probably kept me from real trouble. "Just because you can, doesnt mean you should."  He burned that into our brains. 

Idk what this video clicked in my head and made me think of that but thanks for listening.
